mapper.insert: insert into ai_plan_record (user_id, destination, days, budget, preference, extra, status, error_msg, scenic_count, dropped_spots, latency_ms, model, result_json, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{destination}, #{days}, #{budget}, #{preference}, #{extra}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{scenicCount}, #{droppedSpots}, #{latencyMs}, #{model}, #{resultJson}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failure, coalesce(round(avg(case when status = 1 then latency_ms end)), 0) as avgLatency, coalesce(sum(dropped_spots), 0) as dropped from ai_plan_record where create_time >= curdate()

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as day, count(*) as total, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success from ai_plan_record where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by min(create_time)
select destination, count(*) as total from ai_plan_record group by destination order by total desc limit #{limit}
select id, user_id, destination, days, budget, preference, extra, status, error_msg, scenic_count, dropped_spots, latency_ms, model, create_time from ai_plan_record order by id desc limit #{limit}
